context: Aoi takes Sho-young and Hina-young apple-picking at a small farm.
purpose: Adult mentor leading children on simple outing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Slight breathlessness on the opening — wonder before words. Quick attack, higher pitch. Unfiltered delight, the way a six-year-old announces discovery to the nearest adult.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: They look sweet. Go ahead and pick one.
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried. A small smile in the voice. Warm permission—not instructing, inviting. The comfortable ease of someone watching a child notice something good. Slightly lower register, settling.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: この木、低くて取りやすい。
lines.en: This tree is low—easy to reach.
lines.style: Bright, observant clarity. No showing off, just stating a helpful fact. Quick-paced, practical. The satisfaction of noticing something useful. Open, inclusive tone — offering the information like a gift to the group.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Immediate, decisive joy. Slight urgency—claiming his choice before anyone changes the rules. Energetic but genuine, not performed. A small kid committing to his decision out loud. Clear and proud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Soft, reflective warmth. Not a question really—an observation offered gently. Quiet contentment underneath. Slight elongation on the trailing end, letting the moment linger. The voice of someone noticing and naming something small and good.
